"score_team_1": 2,
"score_team_2": 1,
"team1_win_probability": 58,
"draw_probability": 24,
"team2_win_probability": 18,

"white_hat": "Argentina are reigning World Cup champions and consistently top FIFA rankings, boasting Lionel Messi, Lautaro Martinez, and a settled, experienced squad under Lionel Scaloni. Austria, ranked around the mid-20s, qualified strongly through European campaigns under Ralf Rangnick, playing intense pressing football, but lack the elite individual quality and tournament pedigree Argentina possess.",

"red_hat": "Argentina carry an aura of winners and emotional momentum from their 2022 triumph and continental dominance, inspiring confidence. Austria feel like a plucky, hungry underdog with strong team spirit and Rangnick's energetic identity. Intuitively, Argentina's belief and clutch mentality tilt the emotional balance firmly toward La Albiceleste prevailing.",

"black_hat": "Argentina risk complacency and an aging core; Messi's fitness and fatigue could be decisive late in matches. Austria's aggressive high press can unsettle build-up play and force errors. Defensive lapses, a red card, or a set-piece could swing the contest, and a single counterattack might earn Austria a surprising, deserved result.",

"yellow_hat": "Argentina's blend of world-class attackers, midfield control through Mac Allister and De Paul, and a resilient defense gives them multiple paths to victory. Their game management, penalty-box composure, and ability to control tempo should overcome Austria's pressing, especially with depth allowing fresh legs and tactical adjustments mid-game.",

"green_hat": "An unconventional scenario: Austria's relentless gegenpressing forces an early Argentine mistake, producing a shock lead and a chaotic, end-to-end game. Alternatively, heavy summer heat in North American venues slows Argentina's veterans, prompting Scaloni to rotate, while a young Austrian winger becomes an unexpected breakout star changing the narrative.",

"blue_hat": "Synthesizing: White Hat confirms Argentina's superior ranking, talent, and pedigree; Red Hat reinforces their winning mentality; Yellow Hat highlights tactical and squad advantages. Black and Green Hats inject genuine risk via Austria's pressing and potential fatigue. Weighing dominant quality against credible upset pathways, I forecast a 2-1 Argentina win, assigning 58% to Argentina, 24% draw reflecting Austrian resilience, and 18% to an Austrian upset."
}
